name: LTX-2.3 Pro
description: Lightricks LTX-2.3 Pro is a high-fidelity video generation model for text-to-video and image-to-video, with synchronized audio, first-to-last frame control, and portrait and landscape output up to 4K, in 6, 8 or 10 second clips.

examples.name: Text-to-Video
examples.description: Generate a video with sound from a text prompt

input.prompt: A paper boat drifting across a calm pond at sunrise

code_snippets.label: typescript
curl

examples.name: Image-to-Video
examples.description: Animate a still image into a short video

input.prompt: The camera slowly pushes in while clouds drift past the tower

code_snippets.label: typescript
curl
code_snippets.code:
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "model": "lightricks/ltx-2-3-pro",
  "input": {
    "prompt": "The camera slowly pushes in while clouds drift past the tower",
    "image_uri": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/85/Tour_Eiffel_Wikimedia_Commons_%28cropped%29.jpg",
    "duration": 6,
    "resolution": "1920x1080",
    "fps": 24,
    "generate_audio": true
  }
}'

image_uri.description: HTTPS URI for the first frame

last_frame_uri.description: HTTPS URI for the last frame
